real.Milestone: M3.1, no symbols. With the oracle's own 18 symbols supplied it is 0.9970/0.8579; ./build.sh Fidelity reports both. The ratchet is the without-symbols number because that is what `skala format` does with no project.

constructs.Milestone: M9, re-based: the set grew from 284 files to 323 because thirty-nine spacing and indentation keys stopped being Tier D and each earned a fixture. ⚠ The old population is measured too, and it improved on its own: 284 files scored 0.9664/0.9121 at M3.1 and score 0.9724/0.9155 now, from the labelled-statement and single-line-accessor corrections. All thirty-nine new fixtures are byte-identical to the oracle, so the growth raises the aggregate rather than diluting it — which is the case doc 12 § "a ratchet compares numbers over the same population" says to state rather than assume.
